title: The Aftermath of Milton Flats
author: Kestrel Ishikawa
blurb: Hazel Villalobos, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the demolition date arrives.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
